_comment: Fixture -> OpenAPI response (or request) schema. One entry per file under src/test/resources/json. validate=false entries must say why. Checked by spec.FixtureSpecConformanceTest.
specSource: Vendored from docs.equinix.com/.well-known/api-catalog on 2026-11-11 (Fabric v4 4.34.0; Network Edge ne.json; accessv1, accesstokenv1, stsv1, internetaccess v1+v2, smartview v2, Projects v2 and the Customer Portal specs that have fixtures). Initial mapping derived 2026-11-12 by schema best-fit (derivation=best-fit), by operationId + example name (fabric/beta), or by hand (manual).

core/apiParams_CoreTest.json.reason: SDK endpoint-catalogue test resource (apiParams format), not an API payload

core/empty_paginated_response.json.reason: generic empty {pagination,data:[]} envelope reused for many endpoints; no single response schema

core/errors/apigee_401.json.reason: API-gateway (Apigee) error body; no product specification describes gateway errors

core/errors/operations_400.json.reason: generic Customer Portal error envelope ({errors:[{code,fields,message,messageParams}]}) captured live; none of the vendored Customer Portal specs declares this shape

core/errors/gateway_404.json.reason: API-gateway error body; no product specification describes gateway errors

design/estate/inventory_snapshot.json.reason: SDK-produced estate inventory snapshot (design.estate), not an API payload
